title: zesty roasted jamaican vegetables tagine
description: a flavorful and colorful dish showcasing roasted vegetables from jamaica, cooked to perfection in a tandoor oven with a hint of spice and a touch of velvety texture.

ingredients.name: jamaican allspice
ingredients.notes: use a mortar and pestle to grind the allspice berries

ingredients.name: tandoor seasoning
ingredients.notes: or use a combination of cumin and coriander

instructions: mix together the jamaican curry powder, tandoor seasoning, garam masala, and jamaican allspice in a small bowl
toss the sweet potatoes, red bell peppers, and jamaican red onions with the coconut oil, lime juice, and honey in a large bowl
spread the vegetables in a single layer in the tandoor oven and roast for 20 minutes
mix in the minced garlic and grated ginger and continue to roast for another 10 minutes
transfer the roasted vegetables to a serving dish and sprinkle with the spice mixture
